title: The North Carolina National Guard in the Aftermath of Hurricane Florence
description: The North Carolina National Guard supported recovery and rescue efforts after Hurricane Florence hit the Carolina Coast on Sept. 14, 2018.
keywords: North Carolina National Guard, NCNG, Governor Roy Cooper, hurricaneflorence, Hurricane Florence, helicopter, soldier, search and rescue, engineers, flood
